question: Which Indian musician got the prestigious Academy Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**AR Rahman**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **AR Rahman** is the Indian musician who received the prestigious Academy Award.
 
• He won the award for Best Original Score and Best Original Song for the film **"Slumdog Millionaire"** in 2009.
 
• AR Rahman is a renowned composer, singer, and music producer known for his contributions to Indian and international cinema.
 
• He has also received numerous other awards, including Grammy Awards, BAFTA Awards, and Golden Globe Awards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• AR Rahman was born on January 6, 1967, in Chennai, India.
 
• He is often referred to as the "Mozart of Madras" for his versatile and innovative music compositions.
 
• In addition to his film work, AR Rahman has also composed music for stage productions, television shows, and international events.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Bhushan, India's third-highest civilian award, in 2010.
 
• AR Rahman is also known for his philanthropic efforts and has been involved in various charitable activities and social causes.
